findings.text: src/build/verdict.js:189 recordReviewVerdict runs the lightening check only inside if (base), so when resolveBase finds neither origin/main nor main the check is skipped and a MERGE/PASS verdict is written whatever the chain holds; light Finalise already refuses that state (src/finalise/light.js:277), and the criteria never named the no-base case, so the gap is in the spec (P1-4 from the second Codex re-review, class spec by ruling 57 of the stage-keeper); the test-author adds criteria making the review verb refuse MERGE/PASS with a named line and write nothing when no base resolves, FINDINGS still recorded (ruling 58)

src/finalise/light.js:216 undecidedLightenings builds its decided set from status, blocks and question only, never the answer, so a decision resolved with no answer (rcf define ledger decisions resolve <id> without --answer) satisfies both rcf build verdict review and light Finalise; the criteria never named an answerless decision, so the gap is in the spec (P1-5 from the second Codex re-review, class spec by ruling 57 of the stage-keeper); the test-author adds criteria making the shared check treat a resolved decision with an empty or whitespace-only answer as undecided at both gates, the refusal naming the criterion and the missing answer, a decision with a non-empty answer still passing (ruling 59)
